body.name: Square no-latent atomic projection
body.construction: For \(\ell=0\), \(A\subseteq X\), and \(\mathcal I_A^{\mathrm{atom}}\subseteq\mathcal I\), define \(\Pi_A\mathbf K=(K_{\varnothing},(K_{\{i\}})_{i\in A})\). Thus the required full atomic family is \(\mathcal I_X^{\mathrm{atom}}=\{\varnothing\}\cup\{\{i\}:i\in X\}\).
